title: Management Consultant - AI Trainer
job_description:
Role Title: Management Consultant - AI Trainer

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

Job Summary

micro1 is partnering with a leading AI lab to engage former management consultants for high-impact AI training and evaluation projects. In this role, you'll apply your consulting toolkit, structured problem-solving skills, business analysis expertise, and strong written communication to evaluate how AI models reason through complex business problems and help improve their performance to an expert level.

Scope of Work

Evaluate AI model responses to business strategy and consulting-style problems.
Write high-quality prompts, model answers, and detailed feedback to assess and improve AI performance.
Apply structured consulting frameworks to evaluate reasoning quality, identify gaps, and assess the strength of proposed solutions.
Collaborate with the project team and adapt deliverables as project guidelines and evaluation criteria evolve.

Preferred Qualifications

At least 1 year of experience at a top management consulting firm, such as McKinsey, Bain, BCG, Strategy&, L.E.K., Oliver Wyman, or a similar firm, with at least part of this experience within the past 7 years.
Undergraduate degree from a top-ranked university.
Based in an English-speaking country.
Excellent written English with strong analytical and communication skills.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is hourly, with experts paid for approved hours worked in accordance with project requirements and quality standards.

Start Timeline & Availability

We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts ready to jump in right away. If selected, we expect you to start your first tasks within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

Job Type: Contract

Pay: $245.00 - $280.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40 per week

Benefits:

Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote
